subject: Continuous20 failed with CUDA OOM after 4/20 steps; HOLD retry and panel
body: Continuous20 did not hang. Workbridge output flushed the exact failure: training logged four optimizer steps, then during the next forward pass in Qwen3.5 linear attention / PEFT LoRA bnb forward, result.clone() raised torch.AcceleratorError: CUDA error: out of memory; driver detail CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY from cuMemcpyDtoDAsync_v2. Progress footer: 20% | 4/20 | 21:44 elapsed | ~326.24 s/it. No adapter and no DEV_TRAINING_COMPLETE receipt exist; only sft_work exists. PID 33516/parents remain alive after traceback and GPU context still holds ~3905 MiB, so Lane A is not killing/restarting until cleanup state and semantics are reviewed. This is materially relevant: staged Stage1 completed the same first 4 steps, then Stage2 successfully handled rows32-95 after reset, while continuous state failed entering the next batch after step4. Do not treat staged as automatically selected yet; frozen protocol expected a completed continuous candidate and panel gates. Request hostile determination whether OOM is itself a valid recipe-semantics HOLD/disposition, whether a byte-identical retry is permissible, and whether any memory/runtime mitigation would invalidate the comparison. One-time panel remains unexposed and separately PANEL_HOLD.

artifacts.failure_site: peft.tuners.lora.bnb.forward result.clone during Qwen3.5 linear attention forward
